name: OmaValet
author: Scott Angel
description: Give every app a workspace. Keep your browser on 1, your editor on 2, and chat on 3—without editing Lua. Pick an app and workspace; newly opened windows go where they belong. Optional silent login start, keyboard and drag-and-drop assignment, undo, and window identification. Follows your Omarchy theme, respects existing rules, and opens from the bar or menu. No extra packages. No sudo or pkexec is required.

barWidget.description: Park apps on workspaces, then choose bar or Omarchy menu access.
